server_arguments.name: tokenizer
server_arguments.label: tokenizer
server_arguments.desc: The path of the tokenizer. Only needed when it differs from the model path.

server_arguments.name: tokenizer_mode
server_arguments.label: tokenizer-mode
server_arguments.desc: Tokenizer mode. 'auto' uses the fast tokenizer and model-specific tokenizer hooks if available, 'slow' always uses the slow tokenizer.

server_arguments.name: skip_tokenizer_init
server_arguments.label: skip-tokenizer-init
server_arguments.desc: If set, skip tokenizer initialization and pass input_ids in the generate request.

server_arguments.name: load_format
server_arguments.label: load-format
server_arguments.desc: The format of the model weights to load. 'auto' tries safetensors and falls back to pytorch bin.

server_arguments.name: trust_remote_code
server_arguments.label: trust-remote-code
server_arguments.desc: Whether to allow custom model code from the model repository. Enabled by default in TokenSpeed; pass --no-trust-remote-code to disable.

server_arguments.name: revision
server_arguments.label: revision
server_arguments.desc: The specific model version to use. Branch name, tag name, or commit id.

server_arguments.name: download_dir
server_arguments.label: download-dir
server_arguments.desc: Model download / Hugging Face cache directory.

server_arguments.name: hf_overrides
server_arguments.label: hf-overrides
server_arguments.desc: A dictionary in JSON string format used to override default model configuration values.

server_arguments.name: language_model_only
server_arguments.label: language-model-only
server_arguments.desc: Skip the vision/audio encoders on a multimodal checkpoint and run text-only. Multimodal requests are rejected.

server_arguments.name: dtype
server_arguments.label: dtype
server_arguments.desc: Data type for model weights and activations. 'auto' follows the model metadata.

server_arguments.name: kv_cache_dtype
server_arguments.label: kv-cache-dtype
server_arguments.desc: Data type for KV cache storage. 'auto' uses the model data type. 'fp8' is an alias for 'fp8_e4m3'.

server_arguments.name: kv_cache_quant_method
server_arguments.label: kv-cache-quant-method
server_arguments.desc: KV cache quantization method.

server_arguments.name: quantization
server_arguments.label: quantization
server_arguments.desc: The weight quantization method.

server_arguments.name: quantization_param_path
server_arguments.label: quantization-param-path
server_arguments.desc: Path to the JSON file containing the KV cache scaling factors. Generally required when the KV cache dtype is FP8.

server_arguments.name: moe_activation_dtype
server_arguments.label: moe-activation-dtype
server_arguments.desc: MoE activation precision for the Kimi-K3 fused SiTU MoE. 'bf16' keeps bf16 activations (default), 'mxfp8' uses block-scaled activations.

server_arguments.name: max_model_len
server_arguments.label: max-model-len
server_arguments.desc: The model's maximum context length. Defaults to the value from the model's config.json.

server_arguments.name: gpu_memory_utilization
server_arguments.label: gpu-memory-utilization
server_arguments.desc: The fraction of GPU memory used for model weights and KV cache. Lower it if you see out-of-memory errors.

server_arguments.name: max_num_seqs
server_arguments.label: max-num-seqs
server_arguments.desc: Maximum number of sequences processed concurrently.

server_arguments.name: max_total_tokens
server_arguments.label: max-total-tokens
server_arguments.desc: The maximum number of tokens in the memory pool. Calculated automatically when unset.

server_arguments.name: chunked_prefill_size
server_arguments.label: chunked-prefill-size
server_arguments.desc: Maximum number of tokens the scheduler may issue in a single iteration. Set to -1 to disable chunked prefill. This is TokenSpeed's equivalent of --max-num-batched-tokens.

server_arguments.name: max_prefill_tokens
server_arguments.label: max-prefill-tokens
server_arguments.desc: Maximum prefill-token budget used when chunked prefill is disabled.

server_arguments.name: block_size
server_arguments.label: block-size
server_arguments.desc: KV cache block size.

server_arguments.name: enable_mixed_batch
server_arguments.label: enable-mixed-batch
server_arguments.desc: Allow the scheduler to issue prefill and decode requests in the same iteration.

server_arguments.name: no_enable_prefix_caching
server_arguments.label: no-enable-prefix-caching
server_arguments.desc: Disable prefix caching. Prefix caching is enabled by default in TokenSpeed.

server_arguments.name: disable_kvstore
server_arguments.label: disable-kvstore
server_arguments.desc: Disable KVStore, the host-memory KV cache offload tier.

server_arguments.name: kvstore_ratio
server_arguments.label: kvstore-ratio
server_arguments.desc: Ratio of the KVStore host memory pool size to the device pool size.

server_arguments.name: kvstore_size
server_arguments.label: kvstore-size
server_arguments.desc: The size of the KVStore host memory pool in gigabytes. Overrides --kvstore-ratio when set.

server_arguments.name: kvstore_io_backend
server_arguments.label: kvstore-io-backend
server_arguments.desc: IO backend for KVStore transfers between CPU and GPU.

server_arguments.name: kvstore_mem_layout
server_arguments.label: kvstore-mem-layout
server_arguments.desc: Layout of the KVStore host memory pool.

server_arguments.name: stream_interval
server_arguments.label: stream-interval
server_arguments.desc: The interval (buffer size) for streaming, in generated tokens. Smaller values stream more frequently.

server_arguments.name: stream_output
server_arguments.label: stream-output
server_arguments.desc: Return generated text as a sequence of disjoint streaming segments.

server_arguments.name: data_parallel_size
server_arguments.label: data-parallel-size
server_arguments.desc: The data parallelism size. Inferred from world size and attention TP size when unset.

server_arguments.name: dense_tp_size
server_arguments.label: dense-tp-size
server_arguments.desc: Tensor parallel size for the dense part of the model. Defaults to the number of processes per node.

server_arguments.name: moe_tp_size
server_arguments.label: moe-tp-size
server_arguments.desc: Tensor parallel size for the MoE part of the model. Defaults to the number of processes per node.

server_arguments.name: expert_parallel_size
server_arguments.label: expert-parallel-size
server_arguments.desc: The expert parallelism size.

server_arguments.name: enable_expert_parallel
server_arguments.label: enable-expert-parallel
server_arguments.desc: Enable expert parallelism by automatically setting the expert parallel size to the world size.

server_arguments.name: enable_eplb
server_arguments.label: enable-eplb
server_arguments.desc: Enable the expert-parallel load balancing (EPLB) algorithm.

server_arguments.name: ep_num_redundant_experts
server_arguments.label: ep-num-redundant-experts
server_arguments.desc: Number of redundant experts to allocate in expert parallel mode.

server_arguments.name: load_balance_method
server_arguments.label: load-balance-method
server_arguments.desc: The load balancing strategy used for data parallelism.

server_arguments.name: attention_backend
server_arguments.label: attention-backend
server_arguments.desc: Choose the kernels for attention layers. Selected automatically when unset.

server_arguments.name: kda_backend
server_arguments.label: kda-backend
server_arguments.desc: KDA (Kimi Delta Attention) prefill kernel policy. 'auto' picks the fastest available kernel.

server_arguments.name: moe_backend
server_arguments.label: moe-backend
server_arguments.desc: MoE runner backend.

server_arguments.name: all2all_backend
server_arguments.label: all2all-backend
server_arguments.desc: MoE all-to-all communication backend.

server_arguments.name: deepep_mode
server_arguments.label: deepep-mode
server_arguments.desc: Mode used when DeepEP MoE is enabled. 'auto' selects per batch type.

server_arguments.name: sampling_backend
server_arguments.label: sampling-backend
server_arguments.desc: Choose the kernels for sampling layers. 'greedy' skips sampling-param plumbing entirely.

server_arguments.name: mm_attention_backend
server_arguments.label: mm-attention-backend
server_arguments.desc: Attention backend used by the multimodal encoder.

server_arguments.name: mm_encoder_tp_mode
server_arguments.label: mm-encoder-tp-mode
server_arguments.desc: Multimodal encoder parallelism within each attention TP group. 'weights' shards encoder weights (default), 'data' replicates weights and distributes whole items across ranks.

server_arguments.name: grammar_backend
server_arguments.label: grammar-backend
server_arguments.desc: Backend for grammar-guided (structured output) decoding. 'none' disables it entirely and is the TokenSpeed default.

server_arguments.name: grammar_compile_timeout_secs
server_arguments.label: grammar-compile-timeout-secs
server_arguments.desc: Per-compile wallclock budget before a grammar-constrained request is aborted.

server_arguments.name: disable_any_whitespace
server_arguments.label: disable-any-whitespace
server_arguments.desc: Compile xgrammar JSON grammars in tight mode, with no arbitrary whitespace between tokens.

server_arguments.name: reasoning_parser
server_arguments.label: reasoning-parser
server_arguments.desc: Reasoning-output parser name, e.g. 'deepseek_v31', 'glm45', 'inkling', 'kimi_k25', 'kimi_k3', 'minimax', or 'passthrough'. Also defers JSON schema grammars past the model's reasoning channel.

server_arguments.name: tool_call_parser
server_arguments.label: tool-call-parser
server_arguments.desc: Parser for tool-call interactions, e.g. 'deepseek_v4', 'glm47_moe', 'inkling', or 'kimi_k3'. Handled by the OpenAI-compatible gateway.

server_arguments.name: chat_template
server_arguments.label: chat-template
server_arguments.desc: Built-in chat template name or path to a chat template file. Handled by the OpenAI-compatible gateway.

server_arguments.name: speculative_algorithm
server_arguments.label: speculative-algorithm
server_arguments.desc: Speculative decoding algorithm.

server_arguments.name: speculative_draft_model_path
server_arguments.label: speculative-draft-model-path
server_arguments.desc: The path of the draft model weights. A local folder or a Hugging Face repo ID.

server_arguments.name: draft_model_path_use_base
server_arguments.label: draft-model-path-use-base
server_arguments.desc: Load the draft model from the base model path. Used by MTP checkpoints that ship the draft layers inline.

server_arguments.name: speculative_num_steps
server_arguments.label: speculative-num-steps
server_arguments.desc: The number of steps sampled from the draft model in speculative decoding.

server_arguments.name: speculative_eagle_topk
server_arguments.label: speculative-eagle-topk
server_arguments.desc: The number of tokens sampled from the draft model in each speculative step. Only 1 is supported.

server_arguments.name: speculative_num_draft_tokens
server_arguments.label: speculative-num-draft-tokens
server_arguments.desc: The number of draft tokens verified per step in speculative decoding.

server_arguments.name: speculative_config
server_arguments.label: speculative-config
server_arguments.desc: JSON speculative decoding configuration. Supported keys are method, model, and num_speculative_tokens.

server_arguments.name: enforce_eager
server_arguments.label: enforce-eager
server_arguments.desc: Disable CUDA graph execution and run eagerly.

server_arguments.name: disable_cuda_graph_padding
server_arguments.label: disable-cuda-graph-padding
server_arguments.desc: Disable CUDA graph when padding is needed. Still uses CUDA graph when padding is not needed.

server_arguments.name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
server_arguments.label: max-cudagraph-capture-size
server_arguments.desc: The maximum batch size captured for CUDA graph replay.

server_arguments.name: disable_prefill_graph
server_arguments.label: disable-prefill-graph
server_arguments.desc: Disable the breakable prefill CUDA graph.

server_arguments.name: prefill_graph_max_tokens
server_arguments.label: prefill-graph-max-tokens
server_arguments.desc: Largest token bucket captured by the breakable prefill CUDA graph. Defaults to min(2048, chunked-prefill-size).

server_arguments.name: enable_allreduce_fusion
server_arguments.label: enable-allreduce-fusion
server_arguments.desc: Enable all-reduce fusion for improved decode performance. Auto-enabled on supported single-node TP configurations.

server_arguments.name: enable_nccl_nvls
server_arguments.label: enable-nccl-nvls
server_arguments.desc: Enable NCCL NVLS for prefill-heavy requests when available.

server_arguments.name: enable_symm_mem
server_arguments.label: enable-symm-mem
server_arguments.desc: Enable NCCL symmetric memory for fast collectives.

server_arguments.name: disable_custom_all_reduce
server_arguments.label: disable-custom-all-reduce
server_arguments.desc: Disable the custom all-reduce kernel and fall back to NCCL.

server_arguments.name: disable_overlap_schedule
server_arguments.label: disable-overlap-schedule
server_arguments.desc: Disable the overlap scheduler, which overlaps the CPU scheduler with the GPU model worker.

server_arguments.name: disable_tf32
server_arguments.label: disable-tf32
server_arguments.desc: Disable forcing TF32 on for cuBLAS/cuDNN. TF32 is enabled by default.

server_arguments.name: disable_pdl
server_arguments.label: disable-pdl
server_arguments.desc: Disable programmatic dependent launch (PDL) for kernel launches.

server_arguments.name: weight_loader_prefetch_num_threads
server_arguments.label: weight-loader-prefetch-num-threads
server_arguments.desc: Number of background threads per rank used to prefetch checkpoint shards into the OS page cache.

server_arguments.name: delete_ckpt_after_loading
server_arguments.label: delete-ckpt-after-loading
server_arguments.desc: Delete the model checkpoint after loading the model.

server_arguments.name: skip_server_warmup
server_arguments.label: skip-server-warmup
server_arguments.desc: Skip the warmup requests issued before the server starts serving.

server_arguments.name: seed
server_arguments.label: seed
server_arguments.desc: The random seed.

server_arguments.name: distributed_timeout_seconds
server_arguments.label: distributed-timeout-seconds
server_arguments.desc: Timeout for torch.distributed initialization, in seconds.

server_arguments.name: enable_cache_report
server_arguments.label: enable-cache-report
server_arguments.desc: Return the number of cached tokens in usage.prompt_tokens_details for each OpenAI request.

server_arguments.name: enable_output_logprobs
server_arguments.label: enable-output-logprobs
server_arguments.desc: Enable per-token sampled-token logprobs. Off by default; enabling extends the captured CUDA graph footprint.

server_arguments.name: enable_custom_logit_processor
server_arguments.label: enable-custom-logit-processor
server_arguments.desc: Allow requests to pass custom logit processors to the server. Disabled by default for security.

server_arguments.name: enable_memory_saver
server_arguments.label: enable-memory-saver
server_arguments.desc: Allow saving memory using release_memory_occupation and resume_memory_occupation.

server_arguments.name: enable_nan_detection
server_arguments.label: enable-nan-detection
server_arguments.desc: Enable the NaN guard: sanitize non-finite logits before sampling and flag affected requests.

server_arguments.name: enable_p2p_check
server_arguments.label: enable-p2p-check
server_arguments.desc: Enable the full GPU peer-to-peer access check instead of trusting the driver's P2P report.

server_arguments.name: triton_attention_reduce_in_fp32
server_arguments.label: triton-attention-reduce-in-fp32
server_arguments.desc: Cast intermediate attention results to fp32 to avoid fp16-related crashes. Only affects the Triton attention backend.

server_arguments.name: log_level
server_arguments.label: log-level
server_arguments.desc: The logging level of all loggers.

server_arguments.name: enable_log_requests
server_arguments.label: enable-log-requests
server_arguments.desc: Log metadata, inputs, and outputs of all requests. Verbosity is controlled by --log-requests-level.

server_arguments.name: log_requests_level
server_arguments.label: log-requests-level
server_arguments.desc: 0: log metadata. 1: log metadata and partial input/output. 2: log every input/output.

server_arguments.name: enable_log_request_stats
server_arguments.label: enable-log-request-stats
server_arguments.desc: Log a one-line per-request performance summary (queue/prefill/TTFT timings) when each request finishes or aborts.

server_arguments.name: decode_log_interval
server_arguments.label: decode-log-interval
server_arguments.desc: The log interval of the decode batch.

arguments.name: temperature
arguments.label: temperature
arguments.desc: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic

arguments.name: top_p
arguments.label: top_p
arguments.desc: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered

arguments.name: top_k
arguments.label: top_k
arguments.desc: The number of highest probability vocabulary tokens to keep for top-k-filtering. -1 disables top-k filtering

arguments.name: min_p
arguments.label: min_p
arguments.desc: Minimum token probability, scaled by the probability of the most likely token. Tokens below the threshold are filtered out

arguments.name: max_tokens
arguments.label: max_tokens
arguments.desc: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion

arguments.name: min_tokens
arguments.label: min_tokens
arguments.desc: The minimum number of tokens to generate in the chat completion

arguments.name: stop
arguments.label: stop_sequences
arguments.desc: Sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens

arguments.name: stop_token_ids
arguments.label: stop_token_ids
arguments.desc: List of token ids that stop generation when they are generated. The returned output contains the stop tokens unless they are special tokens

arguments.name: presence_penalty
arguments.label: presence_penalty
arguments.desc: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics

arguments.name: frequency_penalty
arguments.label: frequency_penalty
arguments.desc: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim

arguments.name: repetition_penalty
arguments.label: repetition_penalty
arguments.desc: Penalize tokens based on whether they appeared in the prompt or generated text so far. Values above 1.0 discourage repetition, 1.0 disables the penalty

arguments.name: logit_bias
arguments.label: logit_bias
arguments.desc: Accepts a json object that maps tokens (specified by their token ID in the tokenizer) to an associated bias value. The bias is added to the logits generated by the model prior to sampling

arguments.name: seed
arguments.label: seed
arguments.desc: Per-request random seed for reproducible sampling

arguments.name: ignore_eos
arguments.label: ignore_eos
arguments.desc: Whether to ignore the EOS token and continue generating tokens after the EOS token is generated

arguments.name: skip_special_tokens
arguments.label: skip_special_tokens
arguments.desc: Whether to skip special tokens in the output

arguments.name: thinking_budget
arguments.label: thinking_budget
arguments.desc: Maximum number of tokens the model may spend in its reasoning channel before the answer is forced. Requires a matching --reasoning-parser
